prompt:
Ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic cinematic composition featuring a luxurious decorative envelope as the main subject, positioned in the foreground and occupying a strong central presence in the frame. The envelope is handcrafted, premium and refined, with realistic paper texture, soft matte finish, subtle fibers, elegant folds and precise geometry. It features delicate floral embossing, ornamental details in gold foil, and elegant accents in lilac and rosé, creating a romantic and sophisticated invitation aesthetic. A fine wax seal or ornamental closure adds tactile realism and luxury.

The envelope is placed within a rich floral environment, not a flat backdrop. The background forms a narrative scene — an enchanted garden filled with blooming flowers, soft petals, and delicate foliage — softly blurred but visually recognizable. Roses, peonies, lilacs and small blossoms create depth and context while keeping the envelope as the clear hero. Surrounding elements are carefully curated and symbolic, including floating petals, tiny flowers, subtle sparkles and glowing dust, arranged organically around the envelope. These elements feel natural, gently drifting, enhancing motion and elegance without overpowering the composition.

Lighting is cinematic and dramatic, with a soft key light illuminating the envelope, delicate rim light outlining its edges, and subtle volumetric light rays filtering through the floral scene. Gentle mist, atmospheric haze and floating particles catch the light, creating a dreamy, romantic and premium mood. Shadows are soft, realistic and directional. The color palette is harmonious and luxurious, inspired by high-end floral stationery — rich gold, soft lilac and elegant rosé — with luminous highlights, smooth gradients and controlled contrast.

Composition: foreground-focused, envelope sharply in focus, background softly defocused, strong sense of depth and perspective. Camera: macro lens look, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on envelope texture, seal and floral ornaments, cinematic bokeh in the background lights. Style: photorealistic, hyper-detailed, cinematic fantasy realism, elegant, romantic, premium floral invitation aesthetic. Technical details: 8K ultra-high resolution, realistic materials, global illumination, volumetric lighting, high dynamic range. Aspect ratio: 9:16. Rendering quality: editorial-grade, luxurious, visually enchanting, suitable for premium floral invitations and storytelling visuals.

aberturaPrompt:
The animation begins by focusing on an envelope sealed with a single wax seal. As soon as the wax seal physically detaches and falls to the ground, it is not replaced, duplicated, or regenerated at any point. The envelope remains permanently open after this moment, without any additional seal appearing.
Once the seal is removed, the envelope flap slowly lifts. From within, shimmering sparkles, glittering dust, and trails of radiant light emerge, spreading in a mesmerizing display to the surroundings, with magical beams of luminous particles curving around the envelope, passing in front of and behind it in a three-dimensional spiral. These particles originate only from inside the envelope and also from behind the envelope, increasing in density and brightness as they move.
The radiant light intensifies and expands outward, gradually filling the entire scene. No new physical objects are introduced during this transition. The intense glow of the beams and sparkles transforms into a solid, dazzling white screen in the final frame. The camera subtly and slowly zooms in.
aberturaSlide2Prompt: Remove the envelope from the image completely, revealing only the beautiful background scene, keeping all other elements intact. The result should look natural without any envelope.
